name: Tendai's Fresh Produce
bio: Market-fresh fruit and vegetables sold straight from the stall — call through your order and we'll have it weighed, packed and waiting.

blocks.tagline: Farm-fresh fruit & veg, weighed while you wait
blocks.hero: The stall opens before sunrise most days. Call ahead for bulk boxes, seasonal specials or a delivery run to your gate.
blocks.services:
Bulk boxes for schools & restaurants
Daily deliveries around Mbare & Highfield
Seasonal specials every Friday
Washed & packed on request

faq.a: Around Mbare, Highfield and Glen View — free on orders over $10. Call before 9am for a same-day run.
Cash or EcoCash on collection. Bulk boxes can be held with a deposit.
